title: Prove cloud models improve Susi across successive self-development cycles
goal: Build an offline end-to-end harness through actual self-development orchestration: working fake cloud models propose an observable Susi improvement, native tools implement it in an isolated repository, another model reviews it, real acceptance detects before/after behavior, and the task closes only after gates pass. Exercise at least three successive candidate generations on a fixed held-out suite, including one rejected regression and one unavailable model with working fallback; parallel independent candidates must preserve isolation and budgets. Report measured correctness/quality/performance gains and cumulative cost, never claim self-improvement from generated suggestions or task counts alone. Add deterministic offline release E2E coverage where practical. Implement nonzero tests named cloud_rsi_e2e_* in susi-gawd exercising production wiring.
